scope: All requests use synthetic credentials/records and stubbed fetch. No external service, production endpoint, user storage or paid API was contacted. This is not live authentication or security certification.
checks: Only supported methods and explicit CORS origins pass
JSON type, serialization and byte limits reject malformed requests
Absent or insecure verifier configuration fails closed
Introspection credentials use form encoding before Basic authentication
No arbitrary bearer format or fabricated token is trusted
Active flag and token time bounds are verified
Issuer, audience, subject and exact endpoint scope are mandatory
Verifier failures and oversized responses do not reach paid provider
Server owns model/system and accepts a verified scoped chat
Role, message, part and text limits cannot be bypassed
Remote, SVG, malformed, mismatched and oversized images are rejected
Verified OCR uses a fixed purpose/prompt and bounded data image
Missing provider configuration returns unavailable, not demo success
Provider HTTP errors never leak upstream content or log health data
Malformed, oversized or empty provider replies fail safely
Timed-out network operation aborts and exposes only timeout status
Scoped food vision succeeds without forwarding cycle context
Food request policy and returned numeric/array schema are bounded
Unsigned, fabricated and expired NFC strings never grant access
NFC validation rejects missing/oversized/structured credential input
NFC public navigation is fixed and never premium-by-card-type
Per-instance authenticated backstop bounds repeated provider use
